verification_log.method: Fetched and read the commentary on Daniel 12

12:1 "at that time" = era of 11:36–45; Michael; the time of trouble = Great Tribulation (Jer 30:7; Matt 24:21), worse than Antiochus, AD 70 or the Holocaust; 12:2 bodily resurrection, two resurrections (John 5:29; Rev 20:4–6), "many" may mean all (Baldwin); rejects national-resurrection reading; 12:4 sealing preserves; "run to and fro" more about searching for knowledge (Wood, Newell); quotes Adam Clarke; 12:7 time, times, half = 3½ years, last half of the 70th week; 12:11–12 tentative: 1,260 return, 1,290 government installed, 1,335 judgment of nations (Smith); Antiochus not linked to the numbers
